title: Using the Deep Learning Algorithm to Determine the Presence of Sacroiliitis from Pelvic Radiographs
summary: The publisher full text (Methods and Results, reviewed in Chrome) reports a 1,853-patient pelvic-radiograph study using an EfficientNetV2S CNN to detect sacroiliitis against CT reference. A 70/30 split produced validation AUCs of 0.870/0.869 and accuracy of 86.3%. Approve as a diagnostic model result, with retrospective/reference-cohort and no external-validation limits. This record is limited to the study result and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.
